sections.Profile:
The Moulin Rouge pinball machine, produced by Williams Electronic Games Inc. in May 1965, is an electro-mechanical, single-player game designed by Norm Clark, with artwork by Art Stenholm. Featuring a Parisian nightclub theme inspired by the famous Moulin Rouge, the game includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, six passive bumpers, and five kick-out holes.
